scope: Initial high-priority source-evidence selection from the connected Library census; generated summaries, graphics, backups and duplicate exports are not treated as proof.

publication_modes.FULL_PUBLIC_REDACTED: Publish the complete source only after necessity, personal-data, verification-code, signature and account-data review.
publication_modes.EXCERPT_PUBLIC: Publish the minimum operative passage with page/context and keep the complete original in evidence custody.
publication_modes.IMAGE_CAPTURE: Publish a page/region capture where layout, signature, stamp, table or handwritten element is evidentially material.
publication_modes.METADATA_ONLY: Publish title, date, provenance, hash and proposition; retain the source privately.
publication_modes.PRIVATE_ONLY: Do not publish; preserve for counsel/court/authority review.
publication_modes.NO_EVIDENCE_USE: Derivative, duplicate, superseded or collision item; may be retained for audit only.
